title: PR body + code comments claim reduced-motion keeps a 'steady' highlight, but spawn_fx_draw_highlight returns early (no highlight at all)
detail: Under reduced_motion the highlight is disabled entirely, not pinned steady — presence is lost, contradicting the PR body, the file header, and the proc's own doc comment (the pulse_read 'presence, not motion' intent).
recommended_fix: Either draw a steady band under reduced_motion (skip only the alpha pulse), or amend the PR body and both comments to state the highlight is suppressed under reduced motion.
